## TypeScript Best Practices

- Use strict type checking

import { test, expect } from '@playwright/test';
import { resetAndSeed } from '../support/seed';

// Notes can be added to invoices as well as jobs, newest first.
test.describe('invoice notes', () => {
  test('shows and adds notes on an invoice', { tag: '@core' }, async ({ page }) => {
    await resetAndSeed({
      clients: [{ id: 1, name: 'Acme Ltd', email: 'ops@acme.example' }],
      projects: [{ id: 1, name: 'Website Rebuild', clientId: 1 }],
      invoices: [{ id: 1, projectId: 1, status: 'SENT', lineItems: [{ id: 1, description: 'Work', qty: 1, unitPrice: 100 }] }],
      notes: [{ id: 1, targetType: 'invoice', targetId: 1, text: 'Chase payment', at: '2026-02-01' }],
    });
    await page.goto('/');
    await page.getByTestId('nav-projects').click();
    await page.getByTestId('project-open-1').click();
    await page.getByTestId('invoice-open-1').click();

    await expect(page.getByTestId('invoice-notes')).toBeVisible();
    await expect(page.getByTestId('note-row-1').getByTestId('note-text')).toHaveText('Chase payment');

    await page.getByTestId('note-form-text').fill('Sent reminder');
    await page.getByTestId('note-form-submit').click();
    await expect(page.getByTestId(/^note-row-/)).toHaveCount(2);
  });
});

You can now add notes to invoices as well as jobs. Each invoice page has a Notes section with the newest note first, and you can add a note from there. `bin/e2e` builds the app and the invoice-notes acceptance test passes.

What changed:

- **Database:** a new migration, `V27__invoice_notes.sql`, lets the existing `note` table hold notes for invoices as well as jobs (projects).
- **Server:** a new `InvoiceNoteController` serves `GET` and `POST` at `/api/projects/{projectId}/invoices/{invoiceId}/notes`. `NoteService` gained the matching list and create methods. If the invoice doesn't exist or belongs to a different job, it returns 404 "Unknown invoice".
- **Test seed data:** the spec seeds a note dated `2026-02-01`, but the seed endpoint only accepted full timestamps and would have failed on a plain date. `TestSupportController` now also accepts a plain date and stores it as the start of that day (UTC).
- **Front end:** I turned the job notes component into one shared component, `notes/notes.ts` (`app-notes`), which replaces `project-notes.ts`. If it's given an invoice it shows that invoice's notes; otherwise it shows the job's.
  - On jobs, every existing `data-testid` (`project-notes`, `project-note-list`, `project-notes-empty`, …) and the "No notes on this job yet." text are unchanged.
  - On invoices it uses `invoice-notes`, `invoice-note-list` and so on, plus the shared `note-row-{id}`, `note-text` and `note-form-*` the spec expects.
  - The invoice detail page shows it below Payments.

I only ran the new invoice test, not the rest of the suite. Since the job notes page now runs on the refactored component, that page wasn't re-tested here.

As with job notes, adding an invoice note isn't written to the audit log. The spec doesn't ask for it, so I kept the two consistent.
